items.quote: You can succeed even if you are completely new to the real estate industry.
items.statement: New agents can succeed in the real estate industry.

items.quote: The formula for a new agent should look like this: Training + mentorship support + guidance + leads + self-learning.
items.statement: A successful formula for new agents includes training, mentorship, guidance, leads, and self-learning.

items.quote: Consume podcasts, YouTube videos, and industry portals.
items.statement: New agents should consume podcasts, YouTube videos, and industry portals for learning.

overview: Insights on succeeding as a new agent in real estate.
